ohtani.title: Jacob Misiorowski strikes out six in Brewers' 4-1 win
ohtani.blurb: Jacob Misiorowski fans six in six one-run innings, leading the Brewers to a 4-1 win over the Dodgers

imanaga.title: Blake Butera recaps loss to Cubs
imanaga.blurb: Blake Butera assesses Jake Irvin's outing, credits the Cubs' lineup, talks Jacob Young's offense, and names Jackson Kent tomorrow's starter

suzuki.title: Joshua Báez's historic debut fuels Cardinals' 8-4 win
suzuki.blurb: Joshua Báez hits three home runs in his historic MLB debut to lead the Cardinals to an 8-4 victory over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Charles McAdoo's go-ahead hit leads Blue Jays in win
okamoto.blurb: Charles McAdoo drives in the go-ahead run and Blue Jays pitchers contain the Yankees' lineup in a 4-1 victory

murakami.title: Colson Montgomery collects two RBIs in White Sox win
murakami.blurb: Colson Montgomery hits a two-run double and Andrew Benintendi hits a go-ahead single in the White Sox 4-3 win over the Tigers

matsui.title: Xander Bogaerts leads Padres in 7-5 win
matsui.blurb: Xander Bogarts homers in a three-RBI game and Fernando Tatis Jr. goes yard to lead the Padres to a 7-5 win over the Guardians
